All passed except the Tiptap toolbar-bold character-loss bug.

critical.issue: Double booking possible: careerpilot_booking.bookings had no indexes at all (unique partial index {consultantId,startTime} with slotLocked:true missing; payments also missing its bookingId and sessionId indexes). Duplicate PENDING_PAYMENT bookings were created for the same slot (2026-10-26T04:00Z Riya). Probable root cause: the DB/collection was dropped or reset after booking-service started, and mongoose autoIndex only runs once at model compile. seed.js only calls Consultant.syncIndexes(). The anti-double-booking guarantee depends 100% on this index. I fixed the test data (set the duplicate to PAYMENT_FAILED/slotLocked=false) and created the unique index manually via mongosh; the other booking/payment indexes are still missing.

rca of the issue: Double booking: mongosh showed careerpilot_booking.bookings had only the _id index while AI/auth collections had their schema indexes. Mongoose builds indexes only once when the model is compiled on connection, so if the DB is dropped or reset later (seed.js only syncs Consultant indexes), Booking/Payment indexes are never rebuilt and the E11000-based SLOT_TAKEN path never fires. Mitigation: call syncIndexes()/createIndexes() explicitly at startup and in the seed, and check for the index in /health.
